name: aphrody
description: Single-MCP-server fusion for the aphrody Claude Code plugin. 21 tools across 5 domains : scraping (bxc-mcp Rust subprocess), in-process SQLite memory, aphrody CLI wrappers, GitHub REST proxy, Context7 docs proxy. Replaces bxc-scrapper + bxc + github + context7 with one stdio server. MCPB-packageable.

bxc_daemon_url.title: bxc daemon URL
bxc_daemon_url.description: Base URL of the bxc Bun /api/* daemon. Defaults to local.

memory_db_path.title: Memory SQLite path
memory_db_path.description: Where the in-process memory tools persist data. Auto-created if missing.

aphrody_bin.title: aphrody CLI binary
aphrody_bin.description: Absolute path to the `aphrody` binary. Leave blank to resolve via $PATH (`which aphrody`).

bxc_mcp_bin.title: bxc-mcp Rust binary
bxc_mcp_bin.description: Absolute path to the `bxc-mcp` binary. Leave blank to resolve via $PATH.

github_token.title: GitHub personal access token
github_token.description: Required for aphrody_github_* tools (5 tools : list_issues, create_issue, list_prs, search_repos, get_repo). Needs `repo` scope (or `public_repo`).

context7_api_key.title: Context7 API key
context7_api_key.description: Required for aphrody_context7_* tools (resolve_library, get_docs). Get one from https://context7.com.
